parole.testo: Diminutive of an earlier Proto-Slavic *bъdьňa + -е (-e, diminutive suffix). Possibly of substrate origin, akin to Latin butina (“bottle”), Ancient Greek πῡτῑ́νη (pūtī́nē, “flask”), possibly Proto-Germanic *puttaz (“pot”).

parole.significato: mule (offspring of a male donkey and a female horse)
parole.testo: From Proto-Slavic *mulę, of substrate origin. Compare Latin mūlus, Ancient Greek μύκλος (múklos).
